description: OKLAHOMA CITY, Okla. (KOKH) — Legislation has been filed in several states to ban certain food dyes, including in Oklahoma. State Senator Kristen Thompson (R-Edmond) is the lawmaker behind the effort in the Sooner State. “Senate Bill 4 really came from my experience as a mom,” Thompson said. It was after a soccer game years ago […]
title: State senator giving another go at banning certain food dyes in Oklahoma - Kristen for Oklahoma
